title: The same rule with its room paid back: +460 characters of instruction displaced 932 characters of evidence, so the rule gets a run that does not also shrink the window

reference.note: the shipped arm: `ask=verbatim`, the verb-identity line intact, the same reader, budget, unit, assembly and contract. The rule is judged against this one.

prior.note: the same rule at the unmodified 48,000-character room, which is the run §13.294 read: +4.13 on `MR` with 1.82 fewer evidence turns per question on average. The compensation is judged against this one, because it is the delivery that has to come back.

gates.threshold: **`verbatim-acts`** — the same rule as `42337560027`, so the only difference between the two treatment runs is the room

gates.quantity: `MR` deliveries whose prompt bytes differ from `42310779222`
gates.threshold: **≥ 94 of 121** — the whole reachable population, which §13.294.2 measured; the other 27 read the `operands` block and must stay byte-identical
**no question carries fewer gold turns than it carried at 48,000** — this is the compensation claim: the 460 extra characters of room restore the delivery the instruction displaced

gates.quantity: `MR` questions delivering every gold turn, against 98
gates.threshold: **no fewer than 98** — the same bar gate 10 of §13.290 set and failed; a compensated room has to clear it or the rule cannot be judged at constant evidence

gates.quantity: per-turn source markers across the 500 delivered prompts
gates.threshold: **0** — §13.287.2's saving is only attributable if it is still withheld
**Δ ≥ +3 points** with the resolution printed — the attribution test: if the +4.13 was the evidence reduction, restoring the evidence takes this back below the bar
**no loss ≥ 3 points** — these routes read `verbatim` byte for byte, so a loss here is a dispatch defect rather than a result

gates.quantity: the six questions whose failure in `42310779222` is a stated verb-identity exclusion
gates.threshold: **≥ 4 of 6 flip to correct** — the attribution clause, now on the compensated run: four flips at constant evidence is the rule, four flips at reduced evidence was the bundle
**≤ 29,000,000** against 27,207,570 — 460 extra characters on 94 prompts is about 43,000 tokens, so a bill above this is a different prompt than the one registered
